title: Challenges in Representation Learning: A report on three machine learning contests
review_status: full-text audit complete; contest design and multimodal matching failure checked; not a continual-learning study
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2013-07-01; venue not verified
evidence_note: Hungarian matching enabled a weak base classifier to obtain a perfect multimodal-contest score; only one entrant submitted model for verification. Paper cautions contests are not controlled experiments. Topic-label false positive for continual learning.

title: An Empirical Investigation of Catastrophic Forgetting in Gradient-Based Neural Networks
review_status: full-text audit complete; task-pair design, repeated hyperparameter comparisons, dropout results, and task-dependent activation rankings checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v3 dated 2015-03-04; journal/conference venue not verified
evidence_note: Across three task-pair relationships and 25 random hyperparameter settings per condition, dropout provides the best old/new task trade-off in the tested setup; activation rankings vary by relationship. Does not justify universal method ranking or modern-model generalization.

title: Unifying Visual-Semantic Embeddings with Multimodal Neural Language Models
review_status: full-text audit complete; image/text representation, ranking, and caption-generation experiments checked; not continual learning
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2014-11-10; venue not verified
evidence_note: Joint image-text embedding and caption generation evaluated on Flickr8K/Flickr30K; no sequential task learning or retention experiment. Adjacent multimodal paper, not a direct continual-learning sample.

title: Gated Multimodal Units for Information Fusion
review_status: full-text audit complete; synthetic modality-selection and MM-IMDb comparisons checked; not continual learning
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2017-02-07; venue not verified
evidence_note: On MM-IMDb genre prediction, GMU weighted F-score 0.617 vs linear sum 0.600 and concatenation 0.597; macro F-score 0.541 vs 0.530 and 0.521. Single real dataset/task; no continual adaptation or out-of-domain validation.

title: Attention-Based Structural-Plasticity
review_status: full-text PDF audit complete; selective-plasticity method and MNIST benchmark scope checked
sections_checked: Permuted MNIST and Split MNIST experiments
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2019-03-02; venue not verified
evidence_note: Biologically inspired synaptic-importance method tested on Permuted MNIST and Split MNIST; the sequential Permuted-MNIST setup uses a two-hidden-layer 400-unit MLP. Benchmark evidence only; cross-paper ranking requires matched model, sequence, memory, compute, and metric.

title: Disentangle-based Continual Graph Representation Learning
review_status: full-text audit complete; graph tasks, datasets, temporal partition simulation, comparisons, and small-dataset caveat checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v4; full-text version header inspected; venue not verified
evidence_note: Continual graph link prediction and node classification on FB15K-237/WN18RR and Cora/CiteSeer/PubMed; datasets are randomly partitioned to simulate streams. Authors report gains over selected baselines and note instability for small CiteSeer. Graph-specific outcomes, not directly poolable with vision-language or image classification.

title: UNDIAL: Self-Distillation with Adjusted Logits for Robust Unlearning in Large Language Models
review_status: full-text audit complete; unlearning objective, utility/forgetting trade-off, model scope, and limitations checked; routed away from continual-learning category
evidence_note: Studies removal of targeted learned information, not the usual sequential-learning objective. Reports reduced memorization with utility trade-offs; explicitly limits evaluation to selected models including GPT-Neo and LLaMA-2 7B. Lexical false positive for this topic.

title: PDAC: Efficient Coreset Selection for Continual Learning via Probability Density Awareness
review_status: full-text audit complete; density-based buffer construction, benchmark settings, baseline comparisons, and run counts checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2025-11-12; venue not verified
evidence_note: Evaluates Split-CIFAR10/100 and Split-TinyImageNet in offline/streaming continual-learning settings against uniform, greedy, and other selectors. Reports benefits in its protocols; streaming-table averages use three independent runs. No multimodal benchmark.

title: How does My Model Fail? Automatic Identification and Interpretation of Physical Plausibility Failure Modes with Matryoshka Transcoders
review_status: full-text audit complete; human-labelled dataset, interpretability comparison, generative-model analysis, and stated limitations checked; not continual learning
venue_year_verified: arXiv v2; version header inspected; venue not verified
evidence_note: Uses 3,410 human-labelled generated images plus 5,000 plausible MS-COCO images; MLLM-based feature interpretation; analyzes eight generators. Authors state failure features are not yet integrated into training and rare violations may be missed. Topic-label false positive.

title: Evaluating Time Awareness and Cross-modal Active Perception of Large Models via 4D Escape Room Task
review_status: full-text audit complete; environment size, modality/time conditions, model/API configuration, outcomes, and benchmark boundary checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2026-03-16; venue not verified
evidence_note: Simulated interactive benchmark of 66 scenes/1,032 objects with audio and transient clues; average escape rate GPT-4o agentic setup 72.73%, Gemini 3 Pro 66.67%, Qwen3-Omni Thinking 30.30%. GPT-4o uses separate VL and audio APIs; results do not establish physical-world transfer.

title: MLLM-CTBench: A Benchmark for Continual Instruction Tuning with Reasoning Process Diagnosis
review_status: citation follow-up full-text audit complete; benchmark breadth, methods, task-order design, headline results, and diagnostic-evaluation scope checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v3 dated 2026-02-13; venue not verified
evidence_note: Covers seven tasks/six domains, eight continual-learning methods, and two reversed task orders; reports task/model/method-regime dependence and process-evaluation results. Refutes broad claim that multimodal continual-learning benchmarks are absent; it does not test physical or time-sensitive active perception.

title: CLiMB: A Continual Learning Benchmark for Vision-and-Language Tasks
review_status: independent citation follow-up full-text rechecked; task sequence, forgetting/transfer results, and order caveat checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2022-06-17; venue not verified
evidence_note: Existing multimodal continual-learning benchmark with sequential vision-language tasks, forgetting and downstream transfer; common methods did not yield positive transfer in the tested setup and order mattered. Refutes generic absence claim, but not EscapeCraft-4D's narrower active, time-sensitive audio/visual task.
